It's all coming together, piece by piece. Even Naeva's starting to see it with clear eyes. I'd tell her "I told you so," but I'll save it until after we get the Legacy. No need to jinx it.

Now, there's still a lot of figuring out to do, from location to extraction, and I know Ikande is still lurking in the shadows.
